relevance_note: A scoping review of mental ill-health in systemic autoinflammatory diseases whose Table 1 summarises one previously published Majeed syndrome case with individual-level detail ("the case of Majeed Syndrome in a 13-year-old boy"); no LPIN2 variant is printed.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand, including the supplementary search strategy; no script transcription. Only one in-scope person: the Majeed syndrome case in Table 1 (data row 34, Pinto-Fernandez and Seoane-Reula [86]); Table 1 has no patient-label column, so label rule 3 was used. All other Table 1 studies concern other SAIDs (Behcet, FMF, CAPS, MKD, TRAPS, PFAPA, SAPHO, sJIA, SAIDs collectively) and are out of scope. The paper names neither the gene nor a variant for this person, so the variants table is empty. The 'Country' column (Spain) is the study's country, not the patient's origin, so ethnicity_or_country is 'not reported'. The 'Age' column value '13 years' is recorded as age at the time of report. is_proband left null: the person is the sole participant of a cited case study, but this document is a review and does not call him proband. 'without further reference to mental ill-health' was not treated as excluding any feature. No contradictions found.
